meta.graph_state: the graph BEFORE the §I21 content filter is applied and it is rebuilt — a before-arm for that rebuild, and §G3's merges would move it again
meta.not_tested: candidate EXPANSION (chunks that mention no seed concept but are graph-near). §G1's verifier 4 specifies a ranking comparison, and that is what this is; a null result here is NOT evidence that PPR cannot help the lane.

power.why_it_matters: the graph lane's candidate pool is tiny, so a page-level Recall@k is inert at any k larger than the pool: the cut returns the whole set and BOTH ARMS ARE IDENTICAL BY CONSTRUCTION. `cut_bites_at_k[k]` counts the queries where the cut can actually change the retrieved set. A k with a small count cannot discriminate, and a null result there is UNINFORMATIVE, not negative.

seed_confound.note: concept_embeddings accumulates across ingests and carries no document id, so a top-8 seed can name a concept absent from the current graph. Both arms see the same seeds, so the DELTA is unaffected; the absolute numbers are.
seed_confound.why: a seed absent from the graph matches no Concept node in the ranking Cypher and is skipped by personalized_pagerank, so restricting the seed set to the graph cannot change either arm. Agreement is the evidence the confound is INERT here.
